note: Every entry is actionable: url "builtin://<id>" entries are built and installed by the application itself, offline, on press; url https entries are downloads verified against sha256. No row can only be satisfied by finding a file by hand.

models.name: Builtin ASR (Persian + English)
models.notes: Exemplar-matching acoustic model covering the phrases that ship with the application. 24-sentence test set: WER 0.34 (fa), 0.44 (en).

models.name: Builtin Translation (fa<->en)
models.notes: Bidirectional phrasebook with normalisation for Arabic/Persian character variants. Unknown words pass through unchanged.

models.name: Language pack fa<->en (everyday words)

models.name: Whisper Tiny (multilingual, 75 MB)
models.notes: Smallest Whisper model; fast, suited to short speech. Downloaded from huggingface.co and checked against the expected file size.

models.name: Whisper Base (multilingual, 142 MB)
models.notes: Better accuracy than Tiny at a similar speed. Downloaded from huggingface.co and checked against the expected file size.

models.name: Whisper Small (multilingual, 466 MB)
models.notes: Good accuracy for Persian; needs about 1 GB of RAM. Downloaded from huggingface.co and checked against the expected file size.

models.name: Whisper Medium (multilingual, 1.5 GB)
models.notes: High accuracy; for a machine with enough memory. Downloaded from huggingface.co and checked against the expected file size.

models.name: Opus-MT fa->en (Helsinki-NLP) — standalone pack
models.notes: The phrasebook and installed glossaries saved as a self-contained .osmt; portable to another machine. Built and installed on press.
